[B3] < UserX | 'key' : OldKey , ... > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (deviceA ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ...) , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'resetDevice' cloudA | (deviceA ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindingKey' : '' , 'owner' : nils , ...) , ... > .
[B6] < UserX | 'near' : false , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : true , ... > .
[B7] < UserX | 'near' : true , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : false , ... > .
